_comment: Non-secret settings only. Credentials live in .env (see .env.example) so this file is safe to back up/share. Placeholders in title_format ({title}, {date}) and description_template ([DATE], [STREAM TITLE]) get filled in automatically at upload time.

youtube.description_template:
This stream first aired on [DATE] with the title "[STREAM TITLE]" on the Stackswopo channel.

📌 Also on Rumble (BinScripts): https://rumble.com/user/BinScripts
🎮 Main channel: https://www.youtube.com/@stackswopo_
📺 Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/stackswopo

The stream contains live reactions, jokes, and real-life conversations in my usual unfiltered style.

🔥 Missed the original broadcast? Enjoy the full replay with every moment, from the funny bits to the wild reactions.

Tags: #StacksWopo #StreamReplay #FullVOD #GamingHighlights #FunnyMoments #GTA5 #GTAOnline #Roleplay #StreamerMoments #UncutReplay #Entertainment

rumble._cdp_comment: Recommended: set cdp_url to attach to a Chrome window you're already logged into (e.g. 'http://localhost:9222') instead of storing your password and automating login - see README.md for the launch command. Leave null to fall back to RUMBLE_USERNAME/RUMBLE_PASSWORD in .env.
rumble._category_comment: Rumble REQUIRES a primary category - the submit button stays disabled without one. Must match the dropdown label exactly (e.g. Gaming, Entertainment).

general._censor_comment: Bleeps profanity before upload (reuses the AutoReel censoring engine) so YouTube doesn't age-restrict/demonetize over spoken language. censor_device: null = auto-detect GPU/CPU, or set 'cuda'/'cpu'. censor_bleep_method: 'silence' mutes flagged words, 'beep' overlays a tone.
